role: WorldGenLiquids (the rock-pocket water and lava spring) and the liquid flow it runs: BlockDynamicLiquid.updateTick with its depth, side-source, flow-cost search and pour paths, the lava-water fizz, and BlockStaticLiquid.updateTick's lava fire spread. Used by population and by the server's scheduled block updates.

structs.name: SPRINGS
structs.java: the springs lane's rows of FeatureProbe.FEATURES (springwater, springlava)

structs.name: flow_dir / cost_array
structs.java: BlockDynamicLiquid's per-instance scratch arrays that func_149808_o fills (one per liquid material, as there is one block instance per liquid)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 445-447, function feature_spring: toggles the global ticks_set_immediate flag
function flow_cost: an explicit stack of four frames (depth 1 to 4), no recursion

liquid_update_tick and liquid_static_update_tick are worklist entry points; liquid_step and static_step run BlockDynamicLiquid and BlockStaticLiquid.updateTick as frames, the immediate cascade on the worklist (deepest 895 frames, make -C csrc worklist-depth)

function best_directions_fast (lane/popfeat): func_149808_o over the loaded chunks' cells when every chunk within 5 is loaded: fcf_diamond classifies the 61 cells within 5 into a 121-byte grid, fast_cost searches breadth first (two 32-state layers and a 121-byte seen set on the stack); SP_CLASS, built before main with the material indices
notes: Lava spreads 2 outside the Nether and 1 in it (dim -1). The fizz and the water-branch block drop are delegated to randomtick.c (randomtick_fizz, randomtick_drop). test_ticks.c and test_tileticks.c are listed because they drive scheduled liquid ticks through ticks.c; not verified line by line. The header comment on liquid_static_update_tick says BlockFire.onBlockAdded is not ported; fire.c may since have covered it (not verified). func_149808_o's search (best_directions): when every chunk within 5 of the flowing block is loaded it runs best_directions_fast, reading the chunks' bands directly and searching breadth first (exact: the reads have no effect, and each side's value is its least depth); otherwise the Java-order walk over fc_memo, which keeps the reads that can load a chunk in Java's order (lane/popfeat).
